import sys, json, os, time, random
import numpy as np

# ----- I/O -----
instance_path = sys.argv[1]
budget = float(sys.argv[2])  # wall‑clock budget in seconds
start_time = time.time()
elapsed = 0.0

# ----- Read JSON -----
with open(instance_path, "r") as f:
    data = json.load(f)
n = data["n"]
A = np.array(data["A"], dtype=np.int64)
B = np.array(data["B"], dtype=np.int64)

# ----- Cost evaluation -----
def evaluate(perm):
    """Return cost = sum_i,j A[i,j] * B[perm[i], perm[j]]"""
    total = 0
    for i in range(n):
        pi = perm[i]
        Ai = A[i]
        for j in range(n):
            total += Ai[j] * B[pi][perm[j]]
    return total

# ----- Simple local search with random swaps -----
best_perm = None
best_cost = np.inf

# We keep improving until we run out of time (leave ~0.1 s margin)
while elapsed < budget - 0.1:
    # Propose a random permutation (cheap to generate)
    cand = np.random.permutation(n)
    cand_cost = evaluate(cand)
    if cand_cost < best_cost:
        best_cost = cand_cost
        best_perm = cand
    elapsed = time.time() - start_time

# ----- Output the best permutation (1‑based) -----
print("PERMUTATION: " + " ".join(str(int(x) + 1) for x in best_perm))

import sys, json, time, random
import numpy as np

# ---------- I/O ----------
instance_path = sys.argv[1]
budget = float(sys.argv[2])          # wall‑clock budget (seconds)
start_time = time.time()

# ---------- Load instance ----------
with open(instance_path, "r") as f:
    data = json.load(f)
n = data["n"]
A = np.array(data["A"], dtype=np.int64)
B = np.array(data["B"], dtype=np.int64)

# ---------- Cost evaluation ----------
def evaluate(perm: np.ndarray) -> int:
    """Return sum_i,j A[i,j] * B[perm[i], perm[j]]"""
    total = 0
    for i in range(n):
        pi = perm[i]
        Ai = A[i]
        for j in range(n):
            total += Ai[j] * B[pi][perm[j]]
    return total

# ---------- Initial permutation ----------
perm = list(range(n))
random.shuffle(perm)
best_perm = perm[:]
best_cost = evaluate(np.array(best_perm))

# ---------- 2‑opt hill climbing ----------
# Keep improving while we have time (reserve ~0.05 s for safety)
while True:
    elapsed = time.time() - start_time
    if elapsed >= budget - 0.05:
        break

    improved = False
    # examine all possible swaps
    for i in range(n):
        if time.time() - start_time >= budget - 0.05:
            break
        for j in range(i + 1, n):
            if time.time() - start_time >= budget - 0.05:
                break
            # propose swap i ↔ j
            cand = perm[:]
            cand[i], cand[j] = cand[j], cand[i]
            cand_cost = evaluate(np.array(cand))
            if cand_cost < best_cost:
                best_cost = cand_cost
                best_perm = cand
                perm = cand
                improved = True
                break          # break inner loop, will restart scanning from i=0
        if improved:
            break              # restart scanning from the beginning

# ---------- Output ----------
print("PERMUTATION: " + " ".join(str(x + 1) for x in best_perm))
